title: Integrate VerseGuide location data when API available
description: VerseGuide (verseguide.com) is a community-driven planetary location database for Star Citizen covering Stanton, Pyro, and Nyx. It has POIs, outposts, caves, creature spawns, and detailed location info that could improve our item→source mappings. Their API is currently under development. When available, integrate to: (1) validate/enrich existing source location data, (2) add coordinates and richer location metadata. Check https://verseguide.com/apps periodically for API availability.

title: Add missing Wikelo items to registry
description:
Wiki research found items missing from WikieloRegistry:

**Investigation Results:**
- Jaclium (Ore) - wiki page exists but harvest locations table is empty
- Saldynium (Ore) - wiki page exists but harvest locations table is empty  
- Bluemoon Fungus - no wiki page found
- Vanduul Plating - found in Nyx from Vanduul tech smugglers (low value for interdiction)
- Vanduul Metal - source unclear

**Conclusion:** The wiki doesn't have reliable location data for these items. Adding them with 'Unknown' sources wouldn't improve interdiction intel. Consider closing or deferring until game data is available.

**Note:** Star Citizen 4.0+ removed shop inventory data from game files - community now relies on crowdsourced data (Regolith.rocks, UEX).
close_reason: Wiki data insufficient - location tables empty for missing items. Would add items with Unknown sources which doesn't help interdiction planning.
